must_fire.because: the rule has for: 10m and the wipe removes every series the selector names, so `absent(...)` becomes 1 within a scrape interval and stays.

must_not_fire.because: THIS IS THE POINT OF A-11. A-10 reads `time() - max by (month)(stamp)`, and over zero series that expression has no value — so the rule stays inactive through a total loss of the drift surface. If A-10 fires here, A-11 is redundant and the finding was wrong.
no volume series exists during the wipe, so A-9 has nothing to compare. An empty board renders exactly like a calm one — restated as a prediction because it is the failure this pair exists to end.

clearing.claim: re-pushing the real 2020 numbers clears A-11 within a scrape interval, and A-9 returns for 2020-03 only — the board ends carrying the truth, not a convenient silence.

survival.because: persistentVolume.enabled plus --persistence.file=/data/pushgateway.data, checkpointed every 10s, and pushgateway also writes on a clean SIGTERM. Before this story the same delete emptied the store completely — that is F-050, measured three times on host restarts.
